en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a town in a broad valley with cultivated fields, vineyards on the slopes, and scattered houses and trees. To the right rises a distinctive steep, isolated hill with dense vegetation and a fortification or castle complex on its summit. In the far distance are low rolling hills. At the top edge of the card, in small red print, is the publisher's credit and a number.
